separator.description: null = the parsed source carried no such note (emit nothing).

axisIds.description: axId pair referencing entries of the shared axes list.

dataLabels.description: Group-level data labels (c:dLbls after the ser elements).

gapWidth.description: Bar/column gap width as percent (c:gapWidth, bar group).

grouping.description: Series grouping (c:grouping); defaults per type like the main group.

bare.description: Emit the TOC as a bare complex field instead of the sdt content control Word normally wraps it in. Set by parsing when the source carried no `w:sdt` wrapper, so the document round-trips in its original form.

captionLabel.description: \a option — include captioned items (SEQ-numbered), omitting the caption label and number. Argument is the caption-label identifier. Use \c (captionLabelIncludingNumbers) to keep labels and numbers.

captionLabelIncludingNumbers.description: \c option — include figures/tables/charts numbered by a SEQ field, with caption labels and numbers. Argument is the caption-label/sequence identifier and must match the SEQ field's identifier.

docPartUnique.description: Emit w:docPartUnique inside sdtPr's w:docPartObj (round-trip only).

endInBody.description: The field-end marker lives in a following body paragraph that round-trips on its own — stringify must not inject another end run into the last entry (round-trip only).

endProperties.description: Run properties of the SDT end mark (w:sdtEndPr). An empty object means the source carried a bare `<w:sdtEndPr/>` (round-trip only).

endRPrXml.description: Run properties of the field's closing `end` run (round-trip only). `""` means the end run carried no rPr (stays bare rather than inheriting the control rPr); `undefined` means it matched the control runs' rPr.

entries.description: Rendered TOC entries — the paragraphs between the field's `separate` and `end` markers, round-tripped structurally (HYPERLINK field, tab leader, PAGEREF page number) so Office/WPS display them without regenerating. Omit on fresh generation (field is emitted `dirty`).

entriesFromBookmark.description: \b option - Includes entries only from the portion of the document marked by the bookmark named by text in this switch's field-argument.

entryAndPageNumberSeparator.description: \p option - Text in this switch's field-argument specifies a sequence of characters that separate an entry and its page number. The default is a tab with leader dots.

headRunsXml.description: Verbatim `<w:r>…</w:r>` XML of the field's begin→separate control runs (round-trip only; Word splits the instruction across runs and the split must survive).

headingStyleRange.description: \o option — build entries from paragraphs in built-in heading styles. Argument is a level range as for \l (e.g. "1-3"; 1 = Heading1); empty or omitted lists all heading levels used in the document.

hideTabAndPageNumbersInWebView.description: \z Hides tab leader and page numbers in web page view (§17.18.102).

hyperlink.description: \h option - Makes the table of contents entries hyperlinks.

id.description: SDT identifier (w:id) of the TOC content control (round-trip only).

leading.description: Block content the sdtContent carries before the TOC field — the TOC heading paragraph, a wrapping bookmarkStart (round-trip only).

pageNumbersEntryLevelsRange.description: \n option - Without field-argument, omits page numbers from the table of contents. Page numbers are omitted from all levels unless a range of entry levels is specified by text in this switch's field-argument. A range is specified as for \l.

preserveNewLineInEntries.description: \x Preserves newline characters within table entries.

preserveTabInEntries.description: \w Preserves tab entries within table entries.

rPrXml.description: Run properties carried by the field's begin/instruction/separate control runs, as serialized `<w:rPr>…</w:rPr>` XML (round-trip only; Word parks explicit style overrides — e.g. `b w:val="0"` — on these invisible runs).

runProperties.description: Run properties of the SDT start mark — sdtPr's leading w:rPr element (round-trip only; Word parks the TOC style's font overrides there).

seqFieldIdentifierForPrefix.description: \s option - For entries numbered with a SEQ field, adds a prefix to the page number. The prefix depends on the type of entry; the field-argument text must match the identifier in the SEQ field.

sequenceAndPageNumbersSeparator.description: \d option - When used with \s, the text in this switch's field-argument defines the separator between sequence and page numbers. The default separator is a hyphen (-).

stylesWithLevels.description: \t option — include paragraphs in non-heading styles, each mapped to a TOC level. Combinable with \o (headingStyleRange).

tcFieldIdentifier.description: \f option - Includes only those TC fields whose identifier exactly matches the text in this switch's field-argument (which is typically a letter).

tcFieldLevelRange.description: \l option — include TC fields that assign entries to levels in the argument range `startLevel-endLevel` (integers, start ≤ end). TC fields assigning lower levels are skipped.

trailing.description: Block content the sdtContent carries after the TOC field — the closing bookmarkEnd of a wrapping bookmark (round-trip only).

useAppliedParagraphOutlineLevel.description: \u Uses the applied paragraph outline level.

additionRsid.description: Revision save ID for the paragraph mark (w:rsidR, hex string).

adjustRightInd.description: Whether to automatically adjust right indent for document grid

alignment.description: Paragraph text alignment (left, right, center, justified, etc.)

autoSpaceDE.description: Whether to automatically add space between East Asian and Latin text

autoSpaceEastAsianText.description: Auto-adjust inter-character spacing between numeric and East Asian text regions. Microsoft Word extension — not part of ECMA-376.

bidirectional.description: Whether to render text right-to-left for bidirectional languages

cnfStyle.description: Conditional formatting style for table rows/cells

contextualSpacing.description: Whether to ignore spacing before/after when adjacent paragraphs have the same style

defaultRunRsid.description: Default revision save ID for runs in this paragraph (w:rsidRDefault).

deletionRsid.description: Revision save ID when the paragraph was deleted (w:rsidDel).

emptyProperties.description: The source carried a bare `<w:pPr/>` with no attributes or children. Round-trip marker only — re-emits the empty element instead of dropping it (element presence is part of the source's fidelity).

frame.description: Frame properties for positioning the paragraph

heading.description: Heading level (Heading1, Heading2, etc.) - applies predefined heading style

keepLines.description: Specifies that all lines of the paragraph are to be kept on a single page when possible.

keepNext.description: Keep this paragraph on the same page as the next one when possible; a kept-together set exceeding a page starts on a new page instead.

kinsoku.description: Whether to use Kinsoku forbidden character overflow rules

leftTabStop.description: Position in twips for a left-aligned tab stop

mirrorIndents.description: Whether to swap left and right indent positions on odd pages for mirrored layouts

none.description: numId=0 with a pinned level: cancels the numbering inherited from the style chain while keeping w:ilvl (false covers the level-less form — a bare `<w:numId w:val="0"/>`).

autoStyle.description: Whether the ListParagraph style is auto-applied (default true). Set false when the paragraph style is authored explicitly (e.g. round-tripped documents whose styles.xml may not define it).

instance.description: Instance number for multiple lists with same reference

level.description: Level in the numbering hierarchy (0-8). Omitted when the source w:numPr carried only w:numId (no w:ilvl) — the element then inherits the level instead of pinning one.

reference.description: Reference ID of the numbering definition to use

levelOnly.description: Level-only numPr: the source carried w:ilvl with no w:numId — the numbering definition inherits from the style chain while this element overrides the level. Emits `<w:numPr>` with only the w:ilvl.

revisionOnly.description: Track-change-only numPr: the source carried no w:numId — the whole numbering property set is a tracked insertion whose numbering resolves through the style chain. Emits `<w:numPr>` with only the revision markers (no w:ilvl/w:numId).

numbering.description: Numbering configuration for lists, or false to remove numbering

outlineLevel.description: Outline level for table of contents and document outline (0-9)

overflowPunctuation.description: Whether to allow punctuation to extend beyond text margins

pageBreakBefore.description: Whether to insert a page break before this paragraph

propertiesRsid.description: Revision save ID for the paragraph properties (w:rsidP).

rightTabStop.description: Position in twips for a right-aligned tab stop

run.description: Run properties to apply to all runs in the paragraph.

runPropertiesRsid.description: Revision save ID for the paragraph mark run properties (w:rsidRPr).

shading.description: Background shading/fill color for the paragraph

snapToGrid.description: Whether to snap the current paragraph to the document grid

spacing.description: Spacing before/after paragraph and between lines

suppressAutoHyphens.description: Whether to disable automatic hyphenation for this paragraph

suppressLineNumbers.description: Whether to suppress line numbers for this paragraph

suppressOverlap.description: Whether to prevent text frames from overlapping

tabStops.description: Custom tab stop positions and alignments

text.description: Simple text content for the paragraph. Creates a single TextRun.

textAlignment.description: Vertical text alignment within the paragraph

textDirection.description: Text direction for the paragraph (lr, rl, tb, tbV, rlV, lrV)

thematicBreak.description: Whether to display a horizontal line (thematic break) below the paragraph

topLinePunct.description: Whether to compress punctuation at the start of a line

widowControl.description: Whether to prevent single lines at top/bottom of page (widow/orphan control), defaults to true

endProperties.description: Run properties for the SDT end mark (w:sdtEndPr).

SectionOptions.description:
Options for a document section.

Each section can have its own headers, footers, and page properties.

partNames.description: Source part name per slot (footerN.xml, round-trip only).

Source part name per slot (headerN.xml, round-trip only) — pins the generated part numbering to the source so header parts land in the same files. Fresh documents omit it and get sequential numbering.

author.description: Name of the author who made the change

date.description: Date and time when the change was made (ISO 8601 format)

grid.description: Document grid. Omitted = fresh generation emits Word's CJK default line grid (linePitch 312, type "lines"); a DocGridProperties object emits the provided values; false = explicit off (emit nothing).

pageMargin.description: Page margins in twips (w:pgMar). Three states: omitted (fresh generation defaults to Word's standard margins); a PageMarginProperties object; or false (a parsed source with no w:pgMar is preserved by emitting nothing).

pageSize.description: Page size (w:pgSz). Three states: omitted (fresh generation defaults to A4 portrait); a PageSizeProperties object (emits provided values); or false (a parsed source with no w:pgSz is preserved by emitting nothing).

type.description: Section-break placement: "nextPage"/"nextColumn" start there, "continuous" flows on, "evenPage"/"oddPage" next even/odd page.

SectionVerticalAlign.description: Vertical alignment of content on the page; "both" = justified top-to-bottom.

activeWritingStyle.description: Active writing style checking language/grammar settings

alignBordersAndEdges.description: Align document borders and edges with page edges

alwaysShowPlaceholderText.description: Always show placeholder text for custom XML

attachedTemplate.description: URL of the attached template document (external relationship target)

autoHyphenation.description: Automatically hyphenate words as they are typed (w:autoHyphenation)

bookFoldPrintingSheets.description: Number of sheets per booklet in book fold printing

bordersDoNotSurroundFooter.description: Page borders do not surround footer content

bordersDoNotSurroundHeader.description: Page borders do not surround header content

characterSpacingControl.description: Controls whether punctuation is compressed at line ends

clickAndTypeStyle.description: Click and type paragraph style name

compatibility.description:
Compatibility settings for older Word versions.

Tri-state: omit (undefined) to emit the MS Office default compatSettings for fresh documents; pass an object for explicit control; set `false` to omit `<w:compat>` entirely.

consecutiveHyphenLimit.description: Maximum number of consecutive lines ending with a hyphenated word (w:consecutiveHyphenLimit)

defaultTabStop.description: Default distance between tab stops in twips

displayBackgroundShape.description: Whether to display the background shape in print layout

displayHorizontalDrawingGridEvery.description: Display horizontal gridlines every N units

displayVerticalDrawingGridEvery.description: Display vertical gridlines every N units

doNotDemarcateInvalidXml.description: Do not demarcate invalid XML regions

doNotDisplayPageBoundaries.description: Whether to display page boundaries between pages

doNotHyphenateCaps.description: Hyphenate words in all capital letters (w:doNotHyphenateCaps)

doNotIncludeSubdocsInStats.description: Do not include subdocuments in word count

doNotShadeFormData.description: Do not shade form data fields

doNotTrackFormatting.description: Do not track formatting changes when trackRevisions is on

doNotTrackMoves.description: Do not track move changes when trackRevisions is on

doNotValidateAgainstSchema.description: Do not validate custom XML against schema

docVars.description: Document variables (key-value pairs stored in the document)

drawingGridHorizontalOrigin.description: Horizontal origin for the drawing grid (twips)

drawingGridHorizontalSpacing.description: Horizontal spacing for the drawing grid (twips)

drawingGridVerticalOrigin.description: Vertical origin for the drawing grid (twips)

drawingGridVerticalSpacing.description: Vertical spacing for the drawing grid (twips)

embedSystemFonts.description: Whether to embed system fonts in the document

embedTrueTypeFonts.description: Whether to embed TrueType fonts in the document

evenAndOddHeaders.description: Enable different headers/footers for even and odd pages

formsDesign.description: Document is in forms design mode

gutterAtTop.description: Position gutter at top of page

hideGrammaticalErrors.description: Hide grammatical errors in the document

hideSpellingErrors.description: Hide spelling errors in the document

hyphenationZone.description: Distance from the margin within which hyphenation is avoided, in twips (w:hyphenationZone)

ignoreMixedContent.description: Ignore mixed content in custom XML

mirrorMargins.description: Use mirror margins for facing pages

noLineBreaksAfter.description: Custom kinsoku line break characters after which line breaks are not allowed

noLineBreaksBefore.description: Custom kinsoku line break characters before which line breaks are not allowed

printTwoOnOne.description: Print two pages on one sheet

removeDateAndTime.description: Remove date and time metadata when saving

revisionView.description: Controls which types of revisions are visible

savePreviewPicture.description: Save a preview picture in the document

saveSubsetFonts.description: Whether to save only a subset of the embedded fonts

showEnvelope.description: Show envelope content in the document

strictFirstAndLastChars.description: Enforce strict first and last character rules (CJK)

stylePaneFormatFilter.description: Style pane format filter (which styles to show)

val.description: Legacy Word 2007 hex bitmask — string keeps leading zeros; Word 2010+ writes the boolean attributes instead.

themeFontLang.description: Theme font languages: latin, eastAsian, and complex-script BCP-47 tags

uiCompat97To2003.description: Emulate Word 97-2003 UI behavior (w:uiCompat97To2003, Word 2010+). Absent from the ISO transitional schema but written by Word and declared in the Open XML SDK schema data — kept for round-trip fidelity.

updateFields.description: Update fields when document is opened

w14DefaultImageDpi.description: Default image DPI for pictures inserted in this document (w14:defaultImageDpi)

w14DiscardImageEditingData.description: Discard cropped-out image data when saving (w14:discardImageEditingData)

type.description: Fill pattern: "clear" solid fill, "nil" no fill, "percentN" dot-density percent, "horizontalStripe"/"diagonalStripe"/"horizontalCross"/"diagonalCross" hatch patterns.

textBoxPart.description: External Word 2010 text-box content part. Round-trips `wps:txbx/@r:txbx` while the part bytes remain in DocumentOptions.rawParts.

shapelayout.description: o:shapelayout — shape id map / regroup table / rules.

geometry.description: Preset geometry (a:prstGeom) — a bare string is shorthand for `{ preset: "<name>" }`.

linkedTextBox.description: Linked text box chain (wps:linkedTxbx) — the shape's text lives in the linked part instead of inline w:txbxContent. XSD choice: exclusive with inline text content.

id.description: Chain id shared by all boxes in the link (`@id`, required).

sequence.description: Position of this box in the chain (`@seq`, required).

mcChoiceRequires.description: mc:Choice Requires attribute (e.g. "wps") used to regenerate the AlternateContent wrapper.

normalEastAsianFlow.description: East-Asian vertical text flow (wps:wsp `@normalEastAsianFlow`, default false).

runProperties.description: Structured run properties of the wrapping w:r (round-trip) — emitted before the drawing.

textBoxPart.description: External Word 2010 text-box content part. Round-trips `wps:txbx/@r:txbx` while the part bytes remain in DocumentOptions.rawParts.

vmlFallback.description: Raw XML of the mc:Fallback (VML equivalent) — carried verbatim so the full mc:AlternateContent round-trips. Round-trip channel: captured from a parsed source document — do not hand-author.

vmlFallbackMedia.description: Media referenced by `vmlFallback` `{fileName}` placeholders, registered on generate.

SimpleFieldOptions.description: Simple field types for WordprocessingML documents.

cachedRunsXml.description: Verbatim XML of the cached-value runs when they carry run properties (Word marks field results with w:noProof/rFonts) or split across runs — shapes the plain single-text-run template cannot reproduce.

dirty.description: Field result is out of date

fieldLock.description: Lock the field to prevent updates

SizeRepresents.description: What the bubble size drives: the area or the width.

SmartArtNode.description: A tree node for SmartArt data.

graphicFrameLocks.description: wp:cNvGraphicFramePr locks (null = source had none; omit for default).

nodes.description: Tree-shaped data for the diagram content.

media.description: Images referenced by the data part's own rels (dgm:pt blipFill art).

SolidFillOptions.description:
Union type for all color options supported by solid fill.

Extends the original pattern with additional color types: RGB, scheme, HSL, system, and preset colors.

SourceRectangleOptions.description:
Options for source rectangle cropping.

Each value is integer percent (10 = 10% crop from that edge of the image).

bottom.description: Bottom inset as integer percent (10 = 10% crop from bottom)

left.description: Left inset as integer percent (10 = 10% crop from left)

right.description: Right inset as integer percent (10 = 10% crop from right)

top.description: Top inset as integer percent (10 = 10% crop from top)

before.description: Spacing before the paragraph in twips or as a PositiveUniversalMeasure

ext.description: Raw dgm:extLst inner XML — verbatim round-trip.

scene3d.description: Shared 3D scene for the whole style (dgm:scene3d).

styleLabels.description: Style slots, at least one in a real part (dgm:styleLbl*).

ext.description: Raw dgm:extLst inner XML — verbatim round-trip.

hidden.description: w:hidden — style hidden from the UI.

tableStyles.description: Array of custom table style definitions.

data.description: The sub-document data: raw .docx bytes, ArrayBuffer, or a base64 data URL.

thickness.description: Surface thickness — plain number or percentage string ("N%").

contentPartRId.description: Relationship ID for a content part (w:contentPart with r:id)

deletionRsid.description: Revision save ID when run was deleted (w:rsidDel, hex string).

lastClr.description: Last known RGB color value (optional fallback)

position.description: a:tab `@pos` — tab stop position in EMU.

VML shape styling properties for WordprocessingML documents.

These properties map to CSS-style attributes on VML shape elements and control the shape's appearance, layout, and interaction with surrounding text.

left.description: Specifies the position of the left of the containing block relative to the element left of it. Default is 0.

marginRight.description: Specifies the position of the right of the containing block relative to the shape anchor. Default is 0.

marginTop.description: Specifies the position of the top of the containing block relative to the shape anchor. Default is 0.

positionVertical.description: Specifies the vertical positioning data. Default is absolute.

positionVerticalRelative.description: Specifies relative vertical position data. Default is text.

rotation.description: Specifies the angle that a shape is rotated, in degrees. Default is 0.

top.description: Specifies the position of the top of the containing block. Default is 0.

visibility.description: Specifies whether a shape is displayed. Default is inherit.

width.description: Specifies the width of the containing block. Default is 0.

wrapDistanceBottom.description: Specifies the distance from the bottom of the shape to the text that wraps around it. Default is 0 pt.

wrapDistanceLeft.description: Specifies the distance from the left side of the shape to the text that wraps around it. Default is 0 pt.

wrapDistanceRight.description: Specifies the distance from the right side of the shape to the text that wraps around it. Default is 0 pt.

wrapDistanceTop.description: Specifies the distance from the top of the shape to the text that wraps around it. Default is 0 pt.

wrapEdited.description: Specifies whether the wrap coordinates were customized by the user. Default is false.
